title: 关于《古诗十九首》中的爱情
title_en: On Love in the 'Nineteen Old Poems'
excerpt: 教科书希望我们“从一而终”，把爱驯化成秩序。但《古诗十九首》不是，它脱离了伦理角度，从个体出发书写情感与存在。
excerpt_en: The textbook wants us to be 'faithful to the end' and tame love into order. But 'Nineteen Old Poems' is not like that. It writes about emotions and existence from an individual perspective, detached from ethical angles.

title: 拿破仑的数学水平
excerpt: 按照综合理工高材生尚布雷的说法，在日后的炮兵军官生涯里中，学校里的那些高深数学知识几乎没有派上过用场，最后忘了个精光
excerpt_en: According to the École Polytechnique alumnus Chambray, in his later career as an artillery officer the advanced mathematics taught at school was almost never of any use and was eventually forgotten completely

title: 王民三日记: 贵州1959
excerpt: 1956年后，王民三担任贵州粮食厅党组书记、副厅长、厅长,  其日记记载了西南粮荒之情况, 有相当价值
excerpt_en: After 1956, Wang Minsan served as Party Secretary and Deputy Director, later Director, of the Guizhou Grain Bureau; his diary records the famine conditions in the southwest and is of considerable value

title: 古罗马讲演时的手势
excerpt: 当古代罗马人讲话时，他们同时在使用两种语言：一种是有声的，另一种是无声的.
title_en: Gestures used in ancient Roman oratory
excerpt_en: When ancient Romans spoke, they were using two languages at once: one with sound, the other silent.

title: 关于活在当下
excerpt: 我想要说明一点的是：未来之所以不存在，是因为它不是真实的，它只是我们意识上的延伸，只存在我们的脑海里。
excerpt_en: What I want to illustrate is that the future does not exist because it is not real; it is merely an extension of our consciousness, existing only in our minds.

title: 乡愿
excerpt: 而乡鄙之人往往缺乏勇敢，所以他们的善自然就是“乡愿”
excerpt_en: However, people from rural areas often lack courage, so their goodness is naturally '乡愿'(hypocritical conformism).
